en: The image shows a historical town square with a large, ornate building featuring a clock tower, steep tiled roof, and a sign reading 'Rathskeller.' The square includes a stone fountain in the foreground and several other buildings with gabled roofs. There are people, including children, standing and walking in the square. The scene is black and white, suggesting an early 20th century or late 19th century photograph.
